name: Dannosaki Vlad
source:
Eldest son of a vampire family.
Although Vlad's physical performance is outstanding, his quick temper is a major defect in his character.
But in spite of him being stubborn, emotional and having an old-fashioned way of thinking, he is acting as a substitute father of the family, whom his siblings can rely on.
Because Vlad constantly looks down on people, he is having endless trouble communicating with humans.

He works as a night janitor at "Pikari Cleaning" along with [url=/c4973]Kamata[/url] (a homosexual cross-dresser who has an unrequited crush on him) and [url=/c4977]Saruwatari[/url] (a friendly guy who looks a bit like a monkey).

Favorite sports: boxing, rugby, ice hockey.
Favorite actress: [url=http://mydramalist.info/person/7992/ashikawa_izumi]Ashikawa Izumi[/url].

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
